row.evidence: Cornerstone publishes no pricing (its /pricing/ URL redirects to the LMS product page); Okta's Integration Network lists the Cornerstone OnDemand app with SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans or prices; /pricing/ redirects to the learning-management product page, so SSO, provisioning and API access can only be bought through sales. SCIM evidence comes only from Okta's OIN page (SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate checked); Cornerstone publishes no SCIM endpoint documentation (its help centre needs a customer login), so generic is false and confidence is low. Microsoft's Entra gallery app keeps SSO but its provisioning integration (built on the Cornerstone SOAP web service) is 'no longer supported' and being removed. The REST Employee/OU API is a separately purchased 'Cornerstone API' product (Edge Marketplace), OAuth 2.0 client-credentials only.

entra.notes: Gallery app still says it supports automated provisioning, but the provisioning tutorial says the integration (Cornerstone SOAP web service, admin username/password) is no longer supported and will be removed.
